DC1 · Ethereum Mainnet。达标期间按秒累计，每日发行 1 D: DayCoin is an open monetary experiment. Eligible addresses accrue 1 DC1 per day on Ethereum Mainnet. Explore the rules, limitations and risks.
UBI 是远景，DC1 是从今天开始的实验。: A universal basic income is the horizon. DC1 is where we begin.
没有主人，只有规则。自由加入，自由离开。: No owner. Just rules. Free to join. Free to leave.
达标期间每天累计 1 DC1 · 按秒实时估算: 1 DC1 per eligible day · Estimated each second
合约内记录的全部本金: All principal recorded in the contract
本金达标时持续累计: Rewards accrue while principal meets the threshold
存入 ETH，达到当前门槛后，每天累计 1 枚 DC1（按秒计算，需手动领取）。: Deposit ETH and meet the current threshold to accrue 1 DC1 per day, calculated by the second and claimed manually. Below the threshold, no new rewards accrue. A larger deposit does not increase the rate.
每次 Deposit 都会让未领取奖励和计时永久归零。想保留奖励，请先 Clai: Every Deposit permanently forfeits all unclaimed rewards and resets accrual. To keep your rewards, Claim first.
将已累计的奖励领取为 DC1，本金保持不变。无需等待满一天；当前不再达标，也可领: Mint your accrued rewards as DC1 while keeping your principal in place. No need to wait a full day. Previously accrued rewards remain claimable even if you no longer meet the threshold.
领取金额以交易执行时的链上结果为准: The amount is determined at on-chain execution
自由离开，取回本金。: Free to leave. Take back your principal.
随时取回全部记录本金，没有等待期，不支持部分提款。已持有的 DC1 保留。: Withdraw all recorded principal at any time. There is no waiting period or partial withdrawal. DC1 already in your wallet stays yours.
Withdraw 会放弃全部未领取奖励。想保留奖励，请先 Claim，再取回本金: Withdraw does not automatically Claim: all unclaimed rewards are forfeited. To keep them, Claim before withdrawing.
全部本金，一次取回: All your principal, in one withdrawal
退款不依赖当前是否达标: Withdrawal does not require current eligibility
本金不是购买代币的费用。交易 Gas 由钱包另行支付。: Your deposit is not a token purchase. Transaction gas is paid separately from your wallet.
请在钱包中核对账户、网络与金额。: Verify the account, network and amount in your wallet.
连接钱包后读取 Ethereum Mainnet 链上数据。: Connect your wallet to read your Ethereum Mainnet position.
粗估 · 假设当前仓位自创世持续达标: Rough estimate · Assumes current positions since genesis
当前合约 ETH 余额除以门槛，假设持续达标至今；忽略入场、退出、重置及销毁。: Current contract ETH balance divided by the threshold, assumed eligible since genesis; excludes entry, exit, resets and burns.
当前发行门槛 · 每千日增加 0.1 ETH: Eligibility threshold · Rises by 0.1 ETH every 1,000 days
门槛不足也可取回全部本金。Withdraw 不自动领取奖励，未领取部分将被放弃。: You can withdraw all principal even below the threshold. Withdraw does not claim rewards; unclaimed rewards are forfeited. Smart contract wallets must be able to receive ETH to recover principal.
每次存入，重新计时。: Every deposit starts the clock again.
Deposit 包括追加本金，都会清空未领取奖励。Claim 后已持有的代币不会: Every Deposit, including a top-up, clears unclaimed rewards. Tokens already claimed remain yours. More principal does not increase an address’s daily issuance rate.
合约没有 owner、升级或暂停入口。门槛自部署起每千日增加 0.1 ETH；当: The contract has no owner, upgrade or pause mechanism. The threshold rises by 0.1 ETH every 1,000 days from genesis. Losing eligibility does not erase previously accrued rewards.
交易前核对网络、账户及运行时代码。仓位初值来自 Ethereum PublicN: Before a transaction, this interface verifies the network, account and runtime code. Position snapshots come from Ethereum PublicNode. Pending rewards are estimated locally each second under the contract rules; the actual Claim amount is determined on-chain.
代码不可篡改，制度可以演化。: Fixed code. Room for new ideas.
匿名会话行为统计：不收集钱包地址；尊重浏览器不跟踪设置。: Anonymous session analytics; no wallet addresses collected. Browser do-not-track preferences are respected.
在 Etherscan 查看 Ethereum Mainnet 合约: View the Ethereum Mainnet contract on Etherscan
仅在选择钱包后请求授权。请在钱包内确认连接账户。: Authorization is requested only after you choose a wallet. Confirm the connected account in your wallet.
这是主网交易，使用真实 ETH。最终金额与 Gas 以钱包确认页为准。: This is a Mainnet transaction using real ETH. Check the final amount and gas on your wallet’s confirmation screen.
我们的理想：每人每天一枚。: Our ambition: One Person, One Coin, Every Day.
DC1 尚未实现这一理想：它按达标地址发行，不识别自然人。一人可以控制多个地址，: DC1 has not achieved that ambition. It issues to eligible addresses, not verified people. One person can control many addresses; capital still confers an advantage.
自由是原则，平等是目标，实验是方法。: Freedom is the principle. Equality is the goal. Experimentation is the method.
这是未经独立安全审计的实验。代币可能没有购买力、流动性或长期需求；参与不保证投资: This experiment has not had an independent security audit. Tokens may have no purchasing power, liquidity or lasting demand. Participation offers no guaranteed return; principal is exposed to contract and account risks.
